datasets.name: COCO2017 dataset
datasets.verbatim: In this paper, the pretraining weights obtained by Mask R-CNN on the official COCO2017 [48] dataset are used as the migration learning method.

methods.name: Improved Mask R-CNN
methods.summary: An improved Mask R-CNN model for landslide detection in UAV images. Improvements include adding the CBAM attention mechanism to the ResNet backbone, adding a bottom-up channel to the FPN module, and replacing the RPN with GA-RPN.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the improved Mask R-CNN model lacks a repository or persistent link.
